create_CallbackRegistry: create a CallbackRegistry to manage typed callbacks for CUDA trace events
register_cuda_event_creation_callback: register a callback for CUDA event creation events with an event id argument
register_cuda_memory_allocation_callback: register a callback for CUDA memory allocation events with a memory size argument
register_cuda_stream_creation_callback: register a callback for CUDA stream creation events with a stream id argument
register_cuda_device_synchronization_cal: register a callback for CUDA device synchronization events with no arguments
